protocol.output_format: text for every provider; capabilities are read from manifests
protocol.segmentation: provider default whole-file path; no silent segmentation after provider rejection
protocol.local_warm_state: whisper.cpp and Sherpa load a new process for each run; Qwen uses one server and records first-client versus warm requests
protocol.preprocessing: TranscribeIt prepares mono 16 kHz media using each provider path

commands.convention: $FIXTURE, $RUN, and $SPEAKERS are replaced from the corpus manifest; credentials come only from provider environment variables
commands.qwen3_asr_llama_client: ./target/release/transcribeit run -p openai --api-key local --base-url http://127.0.0.1:18081 --remote-model ggml-org/Qwen3-ASR-1.7B-GGUF --request-timeout-secs 3600 -i $FIXTURE -f text -o output/ti-007-corpus-20260806/runs/qwen3-asr-llama/.../run-$RUN

scoring.word_accuracy: Levenshtein substitutions + deletions + insertions divided by reviewed reference words
scoring.timing: exact-token alignment from hypothesis segments to AMI word times; boundary MAE and reference-token coverage
scoring.speakers: 10 ms DER, 250 ms collar, overlap scored, optimal one-to-one speaker mapping
scoring.ami_overlap_boundary: AMI WER time-orders overlapping reference words by start time with speaker as the stable tie-breaker; interpret it with DER and attributed WER rather than as overlap-invariant cpWER

conclusion.evidence_scope: Dirty-worktree representative-corpus reference, not a regression baseline.
conclusion.quality_scope: Reviewed WER and terms on all successful outputs; AMI timing and DER only where output capabilities permit.
conclusion.long_form: Nine providers produced AMI transcripts; OpenAI diarization rejected input beyond 1,400 seconds.
conclusion.diarization: Deepgram and NVIDIA Riva produced scoreable AMI speaker labels; OpenAI diarization did not reach inference on the long fixture.
conclusion.historical_boundary: The 2026-06 and earlier 2026-08 medical-interview observations remain historical and were not relabeled.
conclusion.remaining_blocker: A clean-commit repetition is still required before TI-007 can be resolved as a regression baseline.
